pages.text: $(italic)Swift, graceful and hungry. Elves are the best mobile fighters but need more food management.$()$(br2)$(bold)Night Vision$(): permanent night vision in dim places, with no UI effect and a smooth shift from dark to light.$(br2)$(bold)Swift$(): permanent +10% movement speed. Pairs very well with Ranger, Samurai and Archmage.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Fragile$(): -8% armor effectiveness from all worn armor, the price of your speed.$(br2)$(bold)Hunger Penalty$(): +20% food drain rate. Elves have a fast metabolism.$(br2)$(bold)Next: carry varied food from day one. Your metabolism makes Spice of Life bonuses matter more.$()
